$comment: Example shot list produced in phase 3. Values are illustrative. Costs are filled in phase 4 from get_cost preflights, never typed by hand. Portrait ids are filled in phase 5 once the user has approved them. identity_input.role is whichever role the chosen video model exposes: image_references for an identity reference, start_image for a first frame made from the portrait. The reference video is never an input.

cast.description: Woman in her late twenties, slim, shoulder-length curly dark hair, medium-light skin tone, mustard knit sweater, small gold hoop earrings, warm expression that turns from skeptical to delighted; the on-camera speaker.

shots.intended_line: Okay, I did not expect this to be good.
shots.visual: Handheld selfie close-up in a bright kitchen at daylight. The host (mustard knit sweater, curly dark hair, gold hoop earrings) holds a slim can toward the camera, skeptical then surprised.

shots.intended_line: Zero sugar. Actually tastes like grapefruit.
shots.visual: Same kitchen, tighter shot. The host (mustard knit sweater, curly dark hair, gold hoop earrings) takes a sip, nods, small laugh.
Product on a wet marble counter, slow push in, condensation on the can, soft window light.
